name: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse!
summary: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse! is a relaxing placement simulation where you organize a huge warehouse full of boxes. Stack packages on pallets, use transport vehicles to place them on shelves, and enjoy turning a messy space into a perfectly organized warehouse step by step.
